transcript.content: Hello, I'm Dr. Smith. It's nice to meet you. Could you tell me what brings you in to see me today?

Hi, Dr. Smith. Nice to meet you too. 

Um, I guess what brings me in is... well, I've been having this issue with eating. Especially on late work nights. I’ll order what I tell myself is just dinner, but then it turns into a whole entrée, sides, dessert, and then I'm grabbing extra snacks from my kitchen on top of that. It just ends up being way, way more food than I’d ever eat if someone were actually sitting across from me.
During these times when you are eating more than you intended, do you feel like you are unable to stop or are unable to control how much you are eating?

Yeah, I do. It’s like... once I start, there’s this point where I’m basically just watching myself do it. I'll keep opening another package, and in my head I’m thinking that I really should stop, but it just feels like the decision has already slipped out of my hands by then.

After these episodes of eating, do you ever feel the need to engage in any specific behaviors to compensate for the amount of food you have consumed, such as vomiting, using laxatives, or exercising excessively?

No, I don't do anything like that. Um, I don't make myself throw up or take laxatives or anything. And I definitely don't go work out afterward. Honestly, I mostly just end up sitting there feeling really uncomfortable and... well, guilty about it. But no, I don't try to get rid of the food.
On average, how many days per week would you say these episodes occur?

Well, I actually looked back at my delivery receipts and my calendar recently to try and figure that out. It's usually at least one night every week where this happens. Sometimes it's more than that, maybe two or three times, depending on how late I'm working. And it's been pretty consistent like that for several months now.

During or after these episodes, do you find yourself eating much more rapidly than normal, eating until you feel uncomfortably full, or eating large amounts when you aren't actually physically hungry?

Yeah, I definitely eat much faster than normal. Usually, I'm sitting at my desk with my Illustrator files open, and I just eat so fast that I barely even notice the taste of the food. I'm just kind of moving from one takeout container to the next. And then... I'll realize I’ve swallowed most of it in just a few minutes.
You mentioned this has been happening for several months; has this pattern of at least one episode per week been occurring consistently for at least the past three months?

Yeah, exactly. Like I was saying about looking back at my calendar and delivery receipts, it's pretty much always at least one night a week, sometimes more. And yes, that specific pattern has definitely been happening consistently for at least the last three months. Probably a bit longer than that, honestly, but definitely the last three months.
